title: Best Gyms in Christchurch 2026 — Prices, Locations and Honest Reviews
meta_desc: Find the best gyms in Christchurch with prices from $15/week, compare 24/7 options and facilities
intro: Christchurch's gym market has seen significant growth since the post-quake rebuild, with City Fitness dominating the scene. However, other players like Anytime Fitness and Jetts are offering competitive pricing and 24/7 access. With prices starting from $15/week, Christchurch residents have a wide range of options to choose from.

sections.heading: City Fitness Christchurch
sections.body: City Fitness has multiple locations in Christchurch, including the CBD, Riccarton, and Papanui. Their membership prices start from $24.95/week for a 12-month contract, with a $99 joining fee. They offer a range of group fitness classes, personal training, and state-of-the-art equipment.

sections.heading: Post-Quake Rebuild of Facilities
sections.body: The post-quake rebuild has seen a significant investment in new gym facilities in Christchurch. Many gyms now offer modern equipment, spacious workout areas, and a range of amenities such as pools, saunas, and steam rooms.
